decision: Do not enable RWKV in learner-facing Coral Classroom yet. Strong recall-prediction evidence warrants local shadow evaluation once licensing, event-log availability, causal feature parity and iPhone XS runtime requirements are resolved.

current_app.learner_memory_model: FSRS-4.5 default weights, text x skill channel
current_app.data_limit: Latest card/skill state and aggregates are persisted; ordered per-review rating, exact duration and timestamps are not durably retained.

upstream_benchmark.metric: Reported mean log loss, excluding same-day reviews. Lower is better. Not measured on Coral Classroom.
limits: RWKV uses extra contextual features and a different held-out-user protocol.
Instant prediction at review time and Curve ahead prediction solve different deployment tasks.
Predictive log loss reduction does not directly imply proportional review workload reduction or improved learning outcomes.

deployment.training_vs_inference: README 6.68x headline is desktop GPU training throughput. It is not an iPhone inference or recall improvement.
deployment.licensing_state: Issue remains open; project README states MIT applies to its new code, not the unlicensed imported srs-benchmark/expertium portions; checkpoint redistribution terms unresolved.
deployment.compression: Current Expertium report describes 332922-parameter d64 and quantized 403-bit/card, 214-bit/note state; compressed variants are credible prospects and are different checkpoints/protocols from the top baseline benchmark.
deployment.phone_limit: No physical iPhone XS or Safari/WASM measurements performed.

evaluation_gate: Clear rights for exact source and checkpoint.
Durable ordered review events and stable card/note/deck/preset identities, with assistance and skill-mode context.
Chronological held-out comparison against a unified current FSRS implementation using only features available at decision time; calibration, log loss, retention/workload and cohort checks.
Offline browser inference parity, bounded intervals and fallback, measured iPhone XS latency/frame pacing/memory.
Shadow evaluation before changing due dates; preserve existing progress.
work_performed: Read-only research and source audit; no scheduler changes, no private learner data read/uploaded, no model training, no upstream messages sent.
